answers.question: You said reads may be sent again on a timeout without limit. Nothing then ends a read that keeps getting no answer, and the conversation could wait forever. What ends it?
answers.recommended: A read that gets no answer is sent again at most twice more. After the third read in a row with no answer, the agent treats the read as failed: at the first lookup it says it cannot look up the orders right now and changes nothing; after a cancel or refund call it does what you said for a failed re-read.
answers.reply: > Reads may be retried on timeout without limit; only commit calls are bounded.

answers.question: After a cancel call with no answer, the agent reads the order again and, if it is still placed or processing, sends the cancel once more under the same confirmation. That second cancel call can also get no answer. The shortest path: the customer says yes; the cancel call gets no answer; the order read again is still processing; the agent sends the cancel once more; that call gets no answer. What does the agent do?
answers.recommended: It sends no third cancel call and no refund call, says it is not known whether the order was cancelled, and hands the case to staff with the reason cancellation unknown.
answers.reply:
Yes, I accept your recommendation.
> Still placed or processing, send the cancel once more under the same confirmation.

answers.question: The staff follow-up reasons are refund not issued, refund status unknown and cancellation unknown. When the refund comes back with an amount other than the one the customer said yes to, the agent hands the case to staff, but none of the three reasons names that case. Which reason does the agent use?
answers.recommended: Add a fourth reason, refund amount differs, to the staff follow-up call.

answers.question: The refund call can return a refund whose status is pending rather than issued. The shortest path: the customer says yes; the cancel call answers cancelled; the refund call returns the refund with status pending. What does the agent tell the customer?
answers.recommended: The order is cancelled and a refund of the amount to the payment method is pending; it promises nothing about when the money arrives, and creates no staff task.
answers.reply:
Yes, I accept your recommendation.
> The agent promises nothing about when the money arrives.
